experiment.description: Laboratory settling-column test: sand was added to a transparent settling column in steps and the sonar, centred and held at a constant height at the water surface, recorded depth to the sand surface for 2-4 minutes at each step. Water was removed after each step to keep the surface, and therefore the transducer, at the same height. Procedure: data_visualization/README.md ('Sand Only') in the software repository.
experiment.column: 4 ft (about 1.2 m) transparent settling column with a yard stick taped to the side
